receipt_digest_note: receipt.json is intentionally excluded from its own digest manifest to avoid a self-referential hash; all other delivered artifacts are embedded and verified.
unresolved_risks: The app log does not provide evaluator request/session metadata for every old comparison, so joins are high-confidence time/vector joins rather than exact metadata joins.
The source app log remains live; the source digest covers only the frozen 184 comparison records, while later comparison events are explicitly excluded.
Fuller contexts contain only persisted user, assistant-text, and tool-request events recoverable before the evaluator request; unpersisted provider state cannot be reconstructed.
